posts.author: shareholder
posts.text: Key takeaways of meeting with management Their current utilization is 92% for cell and 81% for module They have achieved net debt free status this quarter They are upgrading 1 line to topcon, will give them incremental capacity of 150MW. It will generate additional revenue of Rs200cr and EBITDA of Rs70-80cr. It will also train their people for new topcon plant For new plant, location was changed as investment climate has improved in WB and proximity to old plant will increase efficiency. They might be churning profits but are unable to bring investment from even domestic institutes. The stock will go down to 78 levels as of now.

posts.text: Websol’s results posted decent results but SM is filled with people worrying about Websol’s profit margin’s reducing this quarter. If market’s already did not factor this in, then why would a company growing revenue at 70%+ y-o-y basis be trading at PE of 13? It’s only margin’s falling, not the profit’s falling in absolute numbers. From last 2-3 quarters their cell line was already working at 90%+ capacity.
